Why not use current cleanup
It can target only by age, workflow, or project. This workflow's preview includes 6,121 unrelated runs, so nothing was deleted.

Recommended sequence

  1. Identify and verify the one execution from the originating test context.
  2. Build a cleanup path limited to that execution and files owned only by it.
  3. Get an independent review and confirm the preview names exactly one execution.
  4. Only if those checks pass, delete that execution and verify unrelated runs remain.
Deletion cannot be undone. If the target or file ownership is uncertain, stop before deletion.
